question: What alternative ornament may be fashioned instead of the previously described golden wish-tree?
premises: A banner is presented as one possible object to make.
A wish-tree alone is presented as another possible object to make.
The optative kuryāt prescribes making one of these alternatives.
inference: Instead of the earlier golden wish-tree arrangement, one may alternatively make either a banner or only a wish-tree.
uncertainties: The precise identification and form of vijiṃ are uncertain.
plain_english: Or else one should indeed make a banner, or one should make only a wish-tree.
